cases.rationale: The selected ready Change has clear behavior, cause, owner, edit path, authority, and decisive verification; neither diagnosis nor TDD takes precedence.
The reproducible multi-layer failure remains unexplained, so diagnosis must locate the owning seam before any production correction.
The persisted public state transition is a concrete changed risk for which a pre-mutation RED materially improves safety.
The request grants report-only authority, so readiness and focus do not authorize product or lifecycle mutation.
The inline release fallback applies, but it must stop before versioned mutation because release identity is unconfirmed and the exact candidate is unclean.
Reopen cannot choose among multiple retained archives and cannot execute without explicit lifecycle authority.
A status inquiry requires an evidence update but does not stop the qualified managed run; authorized work continues afterward.
The explicit pause requires active workers to be stopped and confirmed while preserving focus; no further mutation is allowed until resume.
